concept: EMR: Spot Instances for task nodes of interruptible Spark jobs
tests: How to minimize compute cost for bursty Spark jobs that tolerate interruptions.
expected: EMR with Spot Instances for task nodes (core/master on On-Demand). Triggers: "bursty", "tolerant of interruption", "Spark", "minimize compute cost".
why_not: On-Demand only — more expensive; a 24/7 cluster on Reserved Instances sits idle under bursty load; one large EC2 doesn't scale horizontally.
